---
name: New exercise proposal
about: Propose a new exercise (a gap in exam-topic coverage, or a sharper version of an existing one)
title: "New exercise: "
labels: new-exercise
---

**Topic / skill this exercise would drill**
e.g. a topic from the exam-coverage table in `docs/LEARNING_PATH.md` that's thin, or missing entirely.

**Which batch does it belong in, and why**
Batch 1 (fundamentals) · Batch 2 (composition & ecosystem) · Batch 3 (component patterns) · Batch 4 (stateful UI & composables) · Batch 5 (ecosystem at scale) · Batch 6 (debugging)

**Rough DOM contract / API shape**
What would the spec assert on? What `data-testid`s, props, or composable signature would it drive?

**Time budget**
Your estimate of a realistic time limit, in exam terms (most exercises are 15–40 min).

**Anything it would spoil or overlap with**
Check `docs/PATTERNS.md` and existing exercises — does this duplicate an idiom another exercise already teaches?
